preconditions: Fresh live nonoverlapping writable CborEncoder and true 9-byte uint8_t buffer; valid buffer+9; flags=0; default CBOR_ENCODER_WRITER_CONTROL=0; exactly one cbor_encode_uint call.
8-bit unsigned char compatible uint8_t; uint64_t is 8 bytes; TinyCBOR cbor_htonll chosen path produces correct network byte order.
TinyCBOR pointer-to-ptrdiff_t conversion: end nonzero; converted end minus converted buffer exactly 9; all subsequent subtraction defined without overflow. No universal portability claim.

libcbor uses correct endian configuration; uint16_t/uint32_t/uint64_t have exact widths; integer promotions and shifts in loaders are defined (ordinary 32-bit int target is a sufficient intended restriction for selected paths).

Input source points to live actual bytes; source_size is truthful and within allocation. Empty-prefix cases use a real non-null buffer with source_size=0. Trailing cases allocate n+1 bytes, up to 10, separately from the 9-byte encoder buffer.

Live callback bundle with correct callable uint8/16/32/64 functions; live recorder context; callbacks return normally, preserve full uint64, do not mutate input or callback bundle or race. Recorder is reset per independent case.
Bytes stay stable across decoding. The transport copies only encoder returned length, never untouched capacity or strlen. All cases conditional on these premises; none have been run.
